# Distribution adaptation

Original author, source and license are retained in UPSTREAM.md and LICENSE.

Changes include portable metadata and resource navigation. Upstream business methodology is preserved.

- Navigation added to long reference references/astro.md.
- Navigation added to long reference references/nextjs-app.md.
- Navigation added to long reference references/vanilla-html.md.
- Navigation added to long reference references/sveltekit.md.
- Navigation added to long reference references/hugo.md.

## Packaging adaptation 1.0.1

Credential documentation uses an unmistakable short placeholder. Turnstile credential input labels and an equivalent scalar environment assignment avoid misclassifying runtime lookups as literal secrets. No account credential, authentication logic or original license was changed.

## Packaging adaptation 1.0.2

If the authorization probe unexpectedly creates a widget and its cleanup fails, the script returns `cleanup_failed` with recovery identifiers instead of `ok`. A successful response without a usable sitekey returns `cleanup_unknown`. The workflow stops for manual inspection or cleanup. Original Cloudflare attribution and license are retained.

Modified upstream files carry per-file distribution notices.
